there's a $3030/ETH pool now, so you don't have to buy RARE first. SWAP ON UNISWAP opens ETH → $3030 straight off the front page, and the site reads all three pools live so you can see which one has depth. NFA.

title: The studio has an X account
blurb:
we're on X now — @RipMaster3030. shipping notes, card drops, and whatever the games do next. the studio is ripmaster3030studios; the account is @RipMaster3030.

title: The arena deals the 67, and never a 1/1
blurb:
the arena deals the 67 field cards. you cannot win a 1/1 there and you cannot stake one — a hero comes from ripping a pack or earning a title, and nothing else. if you hold one it stays on your shelf.

ripmaster3030studios.com/cards/battle.html
alt: THE ARENA: the wager bench, the stack you commit, and the rule printed on the page — the 33 are not in this room.

title: The folder is a collection, not a catalogue
blurb:
the folder shows what you have actually pulled — nine pockets to a page, empty sleeves where cards aren't filed yet. the whole hundred are still one chip away. a binder that shows you everything isn't a binder.

ripmaster3030studios.com/cards/binder.html
alt: The folder: nine-pocket pages, some sleeves filled with cards you have pulled and some still empty.

title: The hundred
blurb:
the deck is 100 cards: 33 hero 1/1s and 67 field cards. every one is a lens — a render keyed by card id, drawn from on-chain state, so the card answers the market it lives in.

ripmaster3030studios.com/cards/deck.html
alt: The deck browser: the hundred as a wall of cards, heroes and field cards banded apart.

title: Every card is a print now
blurb:
every card page is a real print now — four-colour separation, paper tooth, foil that moves with the light, on the same press the folder and the pack reveal use. it turns over onto its own back.

ripmaster3030studios.com/cards/
alt: A card page: the card lit in its room, printed rather than photographed.

title: Packs are priced in dollars
blurb: packs are a dollar target, not a token count: $10 / $12 / $15 / $20 across four tiers. half of every pack burns, half funds the studio. a tier opens when the one before it sells out — no dates. NFA.
alt: The tokenomics page: the pack ladder and where the money goes.

title: THE CITY
blurb:
THE CITY is 3.84 km of generated city and you fly it as a bird. or take it as a squirrel, a cat, a dog — each one gets a different layer of the same place. nothing chases you.

ripmaster3030studios.com/city.html
alt: THE CITY seen from the air: the river, the street grid and the towers of a generated city.

title: Six games, and they're on the front page
blurb:
six games, all in a browser, all free to play: THE CITY, RIP ROCKETER, CLOUD RACER, DOGFIGHT, SECTION 9, THE ARENA. your cards carry powers into them.

ripmaster3030studios.com/arcade.html

title: The front page is a door, not a poster
blurb:
rebuilt the front page around the three things you can actually do: play, look at the cards, rip a pack. the first thing you can press used to be 3,516px down a phone. it's about 430 now.

ripmaster3030studios.com

title: $3030 is live
blurb:
$3030 is live — a SuperRare Liquid Edition, mint-once, 3,030,000 cap. packs buy and burn it, and every burn is permanent. it is a game token, not an investment, and it can go to zero. NFA.
